title: convert2anndata
text: convert2anndata R package bidirectional conversion AnnData (canonical Python single-cell format) either SingleCellExperiment Seurat objects. handles split layers (Seurat), assays, dimensional reductions (obsm ↔︎ reducedDims / Seurat reductions), metadata (obs/var ↔︎ colData/rowData), layers, alternative experiments, aiming faithful roundtrip. encounter issues notice incomplete conversions, please feel free report GitHub issue tracker help us continuously improve.

text: adata AnnData object, character path `.h5ad` file (case read `anndata::read_h5ad()`). counts_layer Name(s) layer `adata$layers` use counts matrix. May single string character vector candidate names; first one present `adata$layers` used. none present, `adata$X` used counts separate `data` layer added. Defaults `c("counts", "raw_counts", "raw_count")`. assay Name resulting Seurat assay. Defaults `"RNA"`. reduction_map Optional named list passed `attach_reductions_seurat()` override extend default obsm-key Seurat-reduction mapping. See `default_reduction_map()`. conda_env Optional conda environment activate reading file. Equivalent calling `setup_anndata_python(conda_env)` first. relevant `adata` path. orig.ident Optional value `orig.ident` column resulting Seurat meta.data. `NULL` (default), value taken `adata$uns$conversion_source` present, otherwise file basename `adata` passed path, otherwise `"AnnData"`. use_raw handle `adata$raw` (separate AnnData snapshot often used scanpy retain raw counts normalising `X`). `"auto"` (default) uses `raw$X` counts layer `counts_layer` candidate matched `adata$raw` set; `TRUE` always uses `raw$X` counts (falls back candidates / `X` missing); `FALSE` ignores raw entirely. attach_obsp Logical. `TRUE` (default), entries `adata$obsp` (cell x cell pairwise matrices, e.g. nearest-neighbor graphs `sc.pp.neighbors`) attached Seurat `Graphs`.

title: convert2anndata 0.3.0
text: convert2anndata now bidirectional converter. addition existing SingleCellExperiment / Seurat → AnnData direction, can convert AnnData (.h5ad) objects Seurat SingleCellExperiment objects: convert_anndata_to_seurat() — AnnData → Seurat. convert_anndata_to_sce() — AnnData → SingleCellExperiment. accept either -memory AnnData object path .h5ad file. AnnData components mapped follows: X / layers → assays, obsm → dimensional reductions, obs / var → cell / feature metadata, obsp → Seurat graphs (Seurat target).

title: convert2anndata 0.3.0
text: cli_convert() now dispatches input file extension: .rds → .h5ad .h5ad → .rds. .h5ad → .rds direction supports -t seurat (default) -t sce choose target object type.

title: convert2anndata 0.3.0
text: New helpers make reticulate ↔︎ Python anndata wiring explicit easier debug: setup_anndata_python() — resolve activate Python environment anndata installed. check_anndata_python() — fail fast actionable message Python, anndata, numpy reachable. diagnose_anndata_python() — print full diagnostic active Python environment. path entry points converters call check_anndata_python() automatically.

title: convert2anndata 0.3.0
text: Conversions robust across Seurat 4 / Seurat 5 layer slot naming. use_raw = "auto" (default) uses adata.raw counts matrix requested counts_layer present; "always" "never" force behaviour, logical value still accepted backward compatibility.
